body:
Applications for Zoning Bylaw changes, Official Plan amendments and Community Planning Permits which do not yet have a decision
Click on an application below to read a summary of the proposed changes, learn about upcoming public meetings, read documents and provide feedback. Use the Ask a question, Read answers tool on the application pages to get your questions answered by the City of Waterloo planner.
Once a decision on an application is completed, the link is moved to the
Applications with decisions
page which has past projects. Some projects that are approved may not have started construction, for some, construction may be in progress or completed. Once construction is completed, the pages will be retained but they will be archived.
View applications with decisions
How the city communicates to residents about the applications
The public has a right to comment on the applications.
To publicize Zoning Bylaw and Official Plan amendments information is typically shared by:
posting a large sign along the frontage of the lands
publishing notices in The Record
posting information on this webpage
hosting
required public meetings at City Council
to discuss the proposed change
mailing notices to properties within 120m of the subject lands
Learn about the amendment process
on our website.
To publicize Community Planning Permit (CPP) applications our actions depend on the class.
For Class 2 applications:
signs are posted along the frontage of the lands
information is posted on
Engage Waterloo
For Class 3 applications and any proposed amendments to the bylaw that require an approval from Council:
signs are posted along the frontage of the lands
information is posted on
Engage Waterloo
notices are mailed to properties within 120m of the subject lands
Learn about the CPP process
on our web page.
Current applications
2 and 8 Father David Bauer Dr, and 6 Merchant Dr
Proposal to amend the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for phase 3 and 4 of the Barrel Yards to add one residential and one mixed-use building. (OPA 65 & Z-25-12 and OPA 66 & Z-25-13)
Learn more
6 to 14 Dietz Ave N (Z-26-03)
Application to lift the holding provision on the lands.
Learn more
9, 33 & 47 Erb St W (OPA 64 & Z-25-17)
Proposal to build a 39 storey mixed-use building containing 412 residential dwelling units, ground-floor commercial space and 933 sqm of indoor/outdoor amenity space.
Learn more
14-20 Lodge St & 195-209 Regina St North (Z-25-21)
Application to lift the holding provision on the lands.
Learn more
14 Roosevelt Ave (Z-26-12)
Application for rezoning to allow building of two stacked townhouse buildings with 24 units.
Learn more
41 Westhill Drive (Z-26-02)
Application to amend the zoning for development of a 6-storey mixed-income apartment building.
Learn more
79 Columbia St W (Z-26-13)
Application to lift the Holding provision on the land to permit development.
Learn more
87-95 Seagram Drive (OPA 73 & Z-26-04)
Application to build a 34 storey mixed-use building containing 522 dwelling units, ground-floor commercial space, office uses above grade and indoor/outdoor amenity space.
Learn more
109, 115, 133 Bridgeport Rd E and 30 Weber St N
Application to amend zoning to build a new multi-tower, mixed-use development that includes a shared podium, three point towers, and a parking structure. (OPA-40, Z-22-10)
Learn more
143 Columbia Street W (Z-23-04)
Application to amend zoning to allow construction of three 25 storey residential towers with ground floor commercial space.
Learn more
145 Lincoln Rd - Minor rezoning
Permit private school as a permitted use.
Learn more
153 Union St E (Z-26-11)
Application to allow an 11 storey and 12 storey building with a total of 244 residential units (356 bedrooms) and 321 sq.m of ground floor commercial space.
Learn more
167 to 171 King St S (Z-25-23)
Application to amend zoning to permit a mixed-use building with two towers (37 and 33 storeys), 834 dwelling units and 791 square metres of commercial space.
Learn more
170 and 180 Columbia St W (OPA 67/68, Z-25-14/15)
Proposal for a multi-phase mixed-use development that consists of 5 high-rise mixed-use towers ranging from 37 to 41 storeys.
Learn more
170 to 200 Northfield Dr W and 570-655 Weber St N
Application to amend zoning for 13 high-rise towers, four 1-storey buildings for commercial and employment uses and publicly accessible spaces (POPS).
Learn more
200 Weber St N (OPA 63, Z-25-05)
An application to build a two-storey retail commercial building with a grocery store on the first floor and offices on the second floor.
Learn more
215 to 229 Lexington Rd (Z-22-08, OPA-37)
Application to amend zoning to demolish an existing long term care facility and construct two new residential apartment buildings
Learn more
239-241 Hemlock St (OPA 74, Z-26-05)
An application to build a 19 storey multi-unit residential building containing 119 dwelling units with 199 bedrooms.
Learn more
247 to 251 Hazel St (Z-25-28)
Application to lift the Holding provision on the Lands.
Learn more
258 Albert St (Z-25-27)
Application to lift the Holding provision on the lands to permit development to proceed.
Learn more
277 and 279 Hazel St (Z-25-16, OPA-69)
Application to amend zoning to permit a 6-storey building containing 40 units.
Learn more
324-330 King St N & 329-331 Regina St N (Z-26-19)
Application to amend zoning to permit a 25-storey mixed-use building at 324-330 King Street North and 329-331 Regina Street North
Learn more
359 to 369 Erb St W (OPA 61, Z-25-06)
The applicant is proposing an 8-storey apartment building containing 224 dwelling units and 230 parking spaces.
Learn more
400 Millennium Boulevard (Z-26-18)
A proposal to change zoning to allow single detached dwellings within Blocks 6 and 8 of Draft Plan of Subdivision 30T-23401.
Learn more
445 Anndale Rd (Z-25-25)
Proposal to amend the zoning to permit 57 townhouse units and the retention of the existing church.
Learn more
446 Albert St (OPA-49, Z-23-13)
Amendments to construction of 13 new residential apartment buildings ranging from 8 to 30 storeys in height, 2833 dwelling units and 97 bedrooms proposed as affordable.
Learn more
500 and 515 Erbsville Rd
Applications to create a new residential neighbourhood with parkland, trail, roads and approx. 175 new dwellings as well as an associated stormwater management block.
Learn more
525 Conestogo Rd W
A minor Zoning Bylaw amendment to permit three new primary uses on the subject lands.
Learn more
585 Laurelwood Dr (30CDM-25402)
Application for draft approval of a Vacant Land Condominium.
Learn more
651 to 663 Erb St W and Regional Lands
Application to amend zoning to expand the existing commercial plaza, create a new municipal road connected to Erb Street West (via a new roundabout), and create a new stormwater management pond.
Learn more
725 Bridge St W (Z-26-14)
Holding (H) Removal to allow the building to be used for a Child Care Centre.
Learn more
OPA 27 and Westhill District Plan Amendment
Application to amend the Official Plan.
Learn more
General Amendment - Zoning Bylaw (Z-26-17)
General amendments to the City of Waterloo Zoning By-law 2018-050.
Learn more
Redevelopment of Places of Worship for housing
Learn more
